title: macOS: embedded game window sends endless InputEventKey events with keycode=0 after a key press
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.8.dev7.official [c971f93e7]
- Does not reproduce in: v4.8.dev1.official [ebbf577a0] and v4.7.2.stable
- Not tested in other versions

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev7 - macOS 27.2 Beta (26B5086k) - Multi-window, 3 monitors (3024x1964 @ 120.00 Hz, 6880x2880 @ 144.00 Hz, 2560x2048 @ 60.00 Hz) - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M2 Pro (Apple8) - Apple M2 Pro (10 threads) - 16.00 GiB memory - CoreAudio (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

When the game runs in the editor's embedded game window on macOS (note that I am running the beta 27.2), pressing a letter key produces the normal key event, followed by extra InputEventKey events that have keycode=0. It does only seem to happen when pressing the Q, W, E, R and G keys. It doesn't happen when the game is running in a separate window. I tested it in a blank project, just this script.

Log from _unhandled_key_input (format: keycode / physical_keycode / unicode / key_label) for other keys without this behavior:

```
Press keycode=49 physical=49 unicode=49 label=49
Release keycode=49 physical=49 unicode=0 label=49
Press keycode=50 physical=50 unicode=50 label=50
Release keycode=50 physical=50 unicode=0 label=50
Press keycode=51 physical=51 unicode=51 label=51
Release keycode=51 physical=51 unicode=0 label=51
Press keycode=52 physical=52 unicode=52 label=52
Release keycode=52 physical=52 unicode=0 label=52
...
```

Log from pressing the Q-key (equivalent for W, E, R and G) in embed:

```
Press keycode=81 physical=81 unicode=113 label=81
Press keycode=0 physical=81 unicode=81 label=0
Release keycode=81 physical=81 unicode=0 label=81
Press keycode=0 physical=81 unicode=81 label=0
Press keycode=0 physical=81 unicode=81 label=0
Press keycode=0 physical=81 unicode=81 label=0
Press keycode=0 physical=81 unicode=81 label=0
Press keycode=0 physical=81 unicode=81 label=0
Press keycode=0 physical=81 unicode=81 label=0
Press keycode=0 physical=81 unicode=81 label=0
(infinite)
```

Log from Q, W, E, R, G in a separate window (or embed in dev1):

```
Press keycode=81 physical=81 unicode=113 label=81
Release keycode=81 physical=81 unicode=0 label=81
Press keycode=87 physical=87 unicode=119 label=87
Release keycode=87 physical=87 unicode=0 label=87
Press keycode=69 physical=69 unicode=101 label=69
Release keycode=69 physical=69 unicode=0 label=69
Press keycode=82 physical=82 unicode=114 label=82
Release keycode=82 physical=82 unicode=0 label=82
Press keycode=71 physical=71 unicode=103 label=71
Release keycode=71 physical=71 unicode=0 label=71
```

### Steps to reproduce

```
extends Node3D

func _unhandled_key_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	var key := event as InputEventKey
	print("%s%s keycode=%d physical=%d unicode=%d label=%d" % [
		"Press" if key.pressed else "Release", " (echo)" if key.echo else "",
		key.keycode, key.physical_keycode, key.unicode, key.key_label])
```

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[godotbug_2026-10-09_11-59-48.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33244896/godotbug_2026-10-09_11-59-48.zip)
